sections.heading: Using Tadazz
paragraphs: Tadazz provides tools for creating, editing and running interactive gameshows. You can explore example games, prepare your own shows and manage your games through your account.
These terms are between you and {{seller_name}}. They take effect on the date shown above. {{territories_audience_and_minimum_age_terms}}

sections.heading: Your account and your shows
paragraphs: Keep your sign-in details private and contact hello@tadazz.com if you believe your account has been used without permission.

Use content that you own or have permission to use. You remain responsible for the questions, answers, images, audio and other material you add to a show, and for obtaining any permissions required for your event.

sections.heading: Plans and purchases
paragraphs: Before buying, review the price, billing period and included allowances shown for your chosen plan. The confirmation for your purchase identifies what you bought.

sections.heading: Running a show
paragraphs: Prepare and preview your show before the event. Check the equipment and connection you intend to use, including any telephone participation you enable.

sections.heading: Content and use of the service
paragraphs: Open-source software notices and licences apply to their respective components. These service terms do not remove rights granted by those licences.

sections.heading: Refunds and responsibility
paragraphs: Read the Refund policy for how to ask about a charge or request a refund. Contact hello@tadazz.com with your purchase reference and the email used to buy.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, contact hello@tadazz.com.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your information
paragraphs: For privacy enquiries relating to Tadazz, contact hello@tadazz.com.

sections.heading: Your choices and requests
paragraphs: You can contact hello@tadazz.com about the information associated with your use of Tadazz. Include enough information to identify your account or event, and avoid sending unnecessary sensitive information.

sections.heading: Requesting a refund
paragraphs: Contact hello@tadazz.com if you have a question about a charge or want to request a refund. Include your order reference, the email used to purchase and a short explanation. Do not send your full payment card details.

sections.heading: When a refund is available
paragraphs: This policy does not replace any mandatory rights that apply to your purchase.
